description: Karnataka's industrial transformation through AI emphasises ethical governance, innovation, and collaboration for sustainable growth, says Minister M.B. Patil.
body_lead: Karnataka is entering a new phase of industrial transformation where artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing, and trusted digital ecosystems will redefine its global competitiveness, said M.B Patil, Minister for Large & Medium Industries & Infrastructure Development. “With over 800 R&D centres, over 18,000 start-ups, and nearly 35% of India’s Global Capability Centres, Karnataka is uniquely positioned to lead this transition,” the Minister told the CII Karnataka State Annual Meeting 2025-26 in Bengaluru on March 10.
